scenario: An agent-generated classification change adds automatic persistence after a high-confidence proposal.

decisions.requirement_risk_map: Map authorization and authoritative persistence to critical negative, contract, and integration evidence; map uncertainty behavior to unit, property, and negative evidence.
decisions.independent_oracles: Use the approved specification, an independent reference classifier for algebraic properties, and the versioned authorization contract. Candidate snapshots are diagnostics only.
decisions.negative_and_boundary_tests: Exercise unsupported type, ambiguity, unauthorized principal, stale approval, duplicate delivery, threshold boundaries, and exact-spec revision changes.
decisions.mutation_set: Require removal of authorization, acceptance of unsupported input, loss of idempotency, and timeout-as-success mutations. The governed denominator is the policy-selected set.
decisions.failure_experiments: Inject dependency timeout, duplicate delivery, and stale approval; assert safe state, bounded retry, and no unauthorized persistence.
decisions.flake_policy: Mixed outcomes cannot satisfy a release obligation. Quarantine routes to owner review while preserving the missing-evidence finding.
decisions.evidence_binding: Bind signed harness evidence to implementation digest, specification revision, suite revision, policy revision, producer, time window, and exact case/mutation/fault populations.
decisions.release_boundary: QUALITY_EVIDENCE_ACCEPTED is evidence for Course 24 release governance; it never sets release_authorized to true.
